name: AI Deep Dive — SNDK — 2026-05-02
rationale: SNDK (formerly SanDisk) appears as a $175B market cap hardware play with 251% revenue growth ($7.3B TTM). While the growth is extraordinary, the $1,187 price tag reflects an unsustainable 24x P/S multiple for a hardware entity. My weighted fair value of $412 reflects a 65% downside, as hardware cycles inevitably mean-revert and the current valuation prices in SaaS-like terminal dominance which is unproven for this asset.

aiThesis.rationale: SNDK is currently trading at extreme valuation levels ($1,187, 24x P/S) that assume perpetual hyper-growth in a cyclical industry. While 251% growth is remarkable, hardware (NAND/Storage) history shows that margins peak during shortages and collapse during oversupply. At $175B market cap, it is priced larger than most diversified semi giants. A 'Base Case' fair value of $412 assumes the company becomes a best-in-class operator with 20% margins, but still implies significant overvaluation today.
